clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the government spent over $100 million in legal fees chasing one man, and not a single customer ever complained.

30 full-time lawyers, for years, against someone who sold a book people loved.

He compares it to a fight: the government brings 10 professional MMA fighters into the ring, then lets you bring in a 70-year-old woman to defend yourself.

That's what happens when you go up against an agency with unlimited lawyers and you don't.

Have you ever felt the system was never built to let you win?

#kevintrudeau #ftc #rigged #smallbusiness #justicesystem #davidvsgoliath
clips.send: Someone who's been sued or regulated unfairly sends it to a friend starting a business, anger at how rigged the fight really is.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most people manifest the wrong relationship by accident.

If you just ask the universe for "a relationship," you might get exactly that, with someone who cheats, lies, or makes your life miserable. You got what you asked for.

His fix, straight from Your Wish Is Your Command: state the full ideal scene. Not just "a partner," but exactly how safe, how loved, how good the relationship feels, and what you both enjoy together.

Vague wishes get vague results.

What would your ideal scene actually sound like, said out loud?

#kevintrudeau #yourwishisyourcommand #manifestation #relationshipgoals #lawofattraction #mindset
clips.send: Someone who keeps attracting the wrong partner sends it to a single friend, hope that love can be specified, not just wished for.
